META_TITLE: Savings Goals — Track Every Goal to the Finish | FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: Create named savings goals with target amounts and dates, track progress, and run sinking funds — all in FincWin. Free to start, private, offline.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Named savings goals with progress bars, target dates and sinking funds. Free, private, offline.
FEATURE_SUBHEAD: Name your goals, set a target and a date, and watch each one progress. FincWin keeps every goal visible and on track.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Saving without a target rarely sticks
PROBLEM_BODY:
“Save more” isn't a plan. Without a named goal, an amount and a date, money slips back into everyday spending.

FincWin gives each goal its own envelope, progress bar and timeline — so saving feels like progress, not deprivation.
HOW_IT_WORKS:
• Name the goal — Emergency fund, new laptop, holiday, deposit.
  • Set target & date — FincWin works out the monthly amount needed.
  • Fund it — assign money each month, manually or as a sinking fund.
  • Track progress — every goal shows percentage complete and time remaining.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Named goals with individual progress tracking.
  • ✓Target dates with auto-calculated monthly contributions.
  • ✓Sinking funds for irregular, recurring expenses.
  • ✓Dashboard view of every goal at a glance.
  • ✓Multi-currency goals supported.
  • ✓Offline & private — no account required.
